name: Oklahoma
modelName: Income shares, combined gross monthly income schedule (43 O.S. § 119)
incomeDefinition: Gross income = earned and passive income from any source (43 O.S. § 118B); self-employment income is net of ordinary and reasonable expenses with a 7.65% deduction. Adjusted gross income adds Social Security paid to the child on the parent's account and deducts support alimony actually paid in a prior case and the deduction for other qualified children (43 O.S. § 118A(1), § 118C). Imputed income may be minimum wage for not less than 25 hours per week (43 O.S. § 118B).

schedule.columns: combined gross monthly income (row applies if equal to or above), then obligation for 1..6+ children
schedule.lookupRule: The schedule heading reads 'If Combined Gross Monthly Income is equal to or above' each row amount (43 O.S. § 119(A)), so the row at or below the income applies. Rows run $650 to $15,000 in $50 steps, preceded by a $50 row.

belowMin.rule: Combined income below $650 falls in the first row ($50 for any number of children) (43 O.S. § 119(A)).

aboveMax.text: Above $15,000 combined gross monthly income: the amount for $15,000 plus an additional amount determined by the court (43 O.S. § 119(B)). More than six children: amount for six plus an amount set by the court (43 O.S. § 119(C)).

shared.text: Parenting time adjustment when the noncustodial parent has at least 121 overnights a year (43 O.S. § 118E(A)(1)). The combined base obligation is multiplied by 2 (121-131 overnights), 1.75 (132-143) or 1.5 (144 or more), split by income shares, each share multiplied by the other parent's percentage of overnights (overnights/365) and offset; the higher owes the difference (§ 118E(D)(2)-(5)). No support is payable by a parent with more than 205 overnights, and the result may not exceed the unadjusted amount (§ 118E(D)(5)). The adjustment is presumptive, not mandatory (§ 118E(C)).

addOns.childcare: Actual annualized child care costs for employment, job search or school are allocated in the same proportion as base support and added to the order (43 O.S. § 118G).
addOns.healthInsurance: Health coverage is reasonable in cost if the child's pro rata premium does not exceed 5% of the responsible parent's gross income; cash medical support may not exceed the lesser of the pro rata share of actual medical expenses or 5% of the obligor's gross monthly income (43 O.S. § 118F(D) and the cash medical provision of § 118F).
addOns.text: Child care and medical support are added to base support (43 O.S. §§ 118F, 118G); transportation costs between homes may be divided by income (43 O.S. § 118D(G)).

lowIncome.rule: No separate self-support reserve in the statute; the schedule's first row sets $50 per month for any number of children below $650 combined income (43 O.S. § 119(A)). A deviation may not seriously impair the obligee's ability to provide basic necessities for the children (43 O.S. § 118H(A)).

emancipation.text: Support runs until 18; a child regularly enrolled and attending high school full time is supported until graduation or age 20, whichever comes first, with no further order needed (43 O.S. § 112(E)). Support for an adult disabled child is possible under 43 O.S. § 112.1A.

testCases.what: payer A's monthly base child support (before child care / medical)
testCases.source: Computed by hand from 43 O.S. § 119: combined $6,000 -> $1,054 for 2 children; A share 4000/6000 x 1,054 = $702.67 (43 O.S. § 118D(B)-(C)).

payer A's monthly base support with 125 overnights (factor 2)

facts.text: Oklahoma's schedule is based on combined gross (not net) income and was last amended in 2000 (Laws 2000, c. 345, emerg. eff. June 6, 2000) (43 O.S. § 119).

The Senate and House Judiciary Committees must review the guidelines and schedule at least every four years using data from the Title IV-D program in the Department of Human Services (43 O.S. § 119.1).
The parenting time adjustment uses a sliding multiplier (2, 1.75 or 1.5) by overnight band starting at 121 overnights (43 O.S. § 118E(D)(2)).

Child support is computed the same way whether custody is designated sole or joint (43 O.S. § 118D(E)); in split custody each parent's obligation is computed and the larger pays the difference (§ 118D(D)).
Oklahoma Human Services Child Support Services publishes an official Excel child support computation calculator and form 03EN025E.

uncertain: OSCN (oscn.net) did not respond from this environment; the statute was read from the Oklahoma Legislature's official Title 43 file (oklegislature.gov), current as downloaded 2026-10-08.

The published schedule has two apparent typographical anomalies, copied as published: $11,300 / 3 children = 1,898 (the $11,250 row is 1,984; the OKDHS Excel calculator's schedule computes 1,988.62) and $14,250 / 3 children = 2,240 (OKDHS Excel: 2,241.25). All other 287 x 6 values match the OKDHS calculator (CSGuidelinesAccessible050125.xlsm) after rounding.
The first schedule row is printed as '50' (income) in the statute; the OKDHS Excel shows 0 and 600 rows with $50 amounts. Treat any income below $650 as the $50 row.
